summary: Phase 149O.1F.2 -- HATP Repository Identity + Trust-Store Foundation Independent Re-Verification: full independent re-verification of Wave 1 (repository_identity.py) and Wave 2 (hatp_bootstrap.py) after the 149O.1F.1 trust-root repair, on the premise that the repair report's own claims must never substitute for independent proof. Verification-only: zero src/pcae/** changes, zero docs/contracts/** changes (both confirmed via git diff --name-only). Status: completed. Completeness: all sections of the governing task addressed (initial inspection; primary-source reading; repair-diff reconstruction; historical + repaired exploit reproduction; resolver call-graph/import-time/environment/CWD/repository-state attacks; fixed-root architecture, agent-precreation, ownership, mode-bit, parent-protection, same-user readiness, and TOCTOU analysis; public API and production call-site enumeration; CRI re-verification incl. same-ID/wrong-root and same-root/wrong-ID; registry-integrity/duplicate/malformed/revoked attacks; reverse-import and activation audits; init/templates/dependency audit; regressions; new adversarial suite; required verification document; findings and verdicts). Files changed: 1 new test file, 1 new doc, PROJECT_STATUS.md, CHANGELOG.md (plus task-lifecycle files). Repair-diff reconstruction: git diff 8b583817~1 8b583817 -- src/pcae/ returns exactly src/pcae/core/hatp_bootstrap.py; single hunk, classified TRUST_ROOT_RESOLUTION + PLATFORM_FAIL_CLOSED only, zero unrelated hunks (programmatically verified: resolve_deployment_authorization(, def _parse_, class HATPTrustStore: all occur zero times in the diff). Historical HOME exploit: reproduced as real against an isolated pre-repair scratch copy extracted via git show 8b583817~1:src/pcae/core/hatp_bootstrap.py -- HOME redirection relocated HATPTrustStore.production().root and a self-authored registry.json there resolved to a real, non-None DeploymentBinding. Repaired HOME exploit: blocked against current source -- production root unchanged; on this real machine the fixed macOS path's parent (/Library/Application Support, root:admin 0755) is not even agent-writable (PermissionError on write attempt); against a reachable synthetic path, resolve_deployment_authorization() returns None for the same fabricated triple. Production root strategy: fixed, platform-level constant, keyed only on sys.platform/os.name, zero environment/CWD/repository/caller dependence. Exact platform roots: macOS /Library/Application Support/PCAE/HATP/trust-store; Linux /etc/pcae/hatp/trust-store; any other platform (including Windows, os.name != 'posix') raises HATPBootstrapUnsupportedPlatformError and fails closed, no environment-derived fallback -- explicitly confirmed rather than inferred from POSIX logic. Environment spoof result: HOME, USER, LOGNAME, USERNAME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, PWD, TMPDIR, TMP, TEMP -- individually, unset, and combined -- all leave the resolved root unchanged. Import-time spoof result: an isolated fresh module load (simulating cold-interpreter import) under pre-spoofed HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME still resolves the same fixed root -- no import-time environment coupling. CWD result: /tmp, /, and nested scratch directories -- no effect (resolver takes no path argument, never calls Path.cwd()). Repository/config result: changing repository root/ID/.pcae state has zero effect on the trust-root resolver; no config loader in this repo defines any hatp/trust_store/bootstrap field. CLI result: zero --trust-store/--hatp-root/--trusted-key/--bootstrap-store or equivalent flags found anywhere in src/pcae/commands/**. Constructor/test-seam result: HATPTrustStore.production() takes zero arguments (inspect.signature-confirmed); the _test_only_root seam is a private, underscore-prefixed, keyword-only constructor parameter, never reachable through .production(), not CLI/environment/config-selectable. Production call-site audit: zero production callers of HATPTrustStore(/.production(/inspect_bootstrap_environment(/resolve_deployment_authorization( exist anywhere outside hatp_bootstrap.py itself and the test suite -- Wave 1/2 is currently fully unwired (Threat-A has no live production target yet; recorded as an architecture-planning observation for Wave 4/6, not a present exploit). Agent-home result: resolved root is never under the current process's own OS-account home by construction (a fixed constant, not a pwd/getpass lookup). Agent-precreation fixed-root result: synthetic agent-precreated roots never report READY (flagged agent_and_admin_share_os_principal). Agent-owned-root result: same outcome -- never READY while agent owns the root. Agent-owned-parent / safe-looking-mode-bit result: 0400/0444/0500/0555 mode bits while remaining owner still never READY -- ownership/principal separation is load-bearing, not permission bits; world-writable parent flagged trust_store_parent_world_writable. Root/admin (distinct-principal positive control) result: could not be exercised end-to-end on this single-user development machine without privilege escalation the agent should not have -- documented limitation, not a code defect; the negative (same-UID never READY) side is fully exercised and passes. Same-user result: live inspect_bootstrap_environment() check on this real machine returns UNAVAILABLE (fixed path absent here), never READY; synthetic same-UID-with-well-formed-registry case also never READY. Privilege-escalation limitation: inspect_bootstrap_environment() explicitly and accurately disclaims inability to mechanically detect sudo/setuid/group-membership escalation paths -- honest, not overclaimed. Missing-root result: UNAVAILABLE / trust_store_missing, no auto-provisioning (grep-confirmed: no mkdir/touch/write-registry call against the root anywhere in the module). Unsupported-platform result: os.name != 'posix' and unrecognized sys.platform values both raise HATPBootstrapUnsupportedPlatformError; Windows disposition explicitly confirmed fail-closed (covered by os.name != 'posix'), not inferred. Repository identity model: re-verified UUID4 generation, idempotent ensure/create, fail-closed malformed-identity handling with no auto-heal, symlink-write refusal. Clone result: a fresh directory has no identity until init/ensure runs (the identity file is gitignored, confirmed via templates.py). Full-copy result: a copied identity file persists the ID locally but an empty trust-store registry still yields no authorization for it. Worktree result: independent directories get independent identities. Path-move result: the identity/ID survives a directory move; the canonical deployment root string changes, so any binding registered against the old root no longer matches. Repository-ID-theft result: copying a real repo's ID into a different directory gains no authorization at the new canonical root. Same-ID/wrong-root result: a binding registered for ID at root A does not authorize that same ID presented at root B -- confirmed None (mandatory check). Same-root/wrong-ID result: a binding registered at root A for ID A does not authorize a different ID presented at root A -- confirmed None (mandatory check). Canonical-root result: /a/repo, /a/./repo, /a/x/../repo all canonicalize identically; a symlink alias resolves to the same canonical string as its real target; a bounded, disclosed (not overclaimed) TOCTOU window exists between readiness's stat checks and the registry read, exploitable only by a principal that can already write the protected parent. Duplicate-record result: duplicate deployment_bindings entries for the same repository_id raise HATPTrustStoreMalformedError, fail closed, no last-write-wins. Malformed-registry result: invalid JSON raises HATPTrustStoreMalformedError; missing registry returns None (a deliberately distinct, correctly separated code path from malformed). Revocation result: a revoked binding (status=revoked) yields no authorization. Authority-scope result: the authority_scope field round-trips on a valid binding for caller-side filtering; the module itself does not filter by scope, a documented caller responsibility, not a gap. Public API audit: HATPTrustStore's public symbol set (production, root, environment_status, load_repository_enrollment, lookup_principal, lookup_signer, lookup_authority, signer_revoked, resolve_deployment_authorization) contains no approval/proof-suggestive name. Import/reverse-import boundary: hatp_bootstrap.py imports only repository_identity.py; repository_identity.py imports only pcae.core.paths; rollback_approval_evidence.py, permission_broker*.py, mutation_permission.py, agent.py, and commands/agent.py contain zero references to hatp_bootstrap or repository_identity (grep-confirmed against full file text). Activation result / approval_present audit: zero HATP_TRUSTED_OPERATIONAL/approval_present/verify_hatp/HumanApprovalProvenanceProof/signature/attestation/human_presence symbol is defined (AST-confirmed, distinguishing prose-disclaimer docstring mentions from actual definitions) anywhere in hatp_bootstrap.py; no production HATP activation path exists in Wave 1/2. B-149O.1F-1 status: CONFIRMED CLOSED, independently re-evaluated. B-149O-1 through B-149O-4 status: remain OPEN, unaffected. F-149O.1C-1 status: remains pending actual Wave-3 proof-schema implementation. F-149O.1C-2 status: remains editorial debt only. 149O.1E regression: included in the 103-passed combined foundation regression (unchanged). 149O.1F regression: included in the same 103-passed combined foundation regression; historical reproducer left untouched, byte-identical evidence preserved. 149O.1F.1 regression: same combined 103-passed figure (30 of which are 149O.1F.1's own suite). HATP contract regression (149O.1C): 95 passed. HATP plan regression (149O.1D): 32 passed. RAE/PB/agent regression: 5381 passed / 5 failed on a broadened suite set (beyond the 149O.1F.1 baseline's narrower selection); all 5 confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to this phase via a git-stash re-run with only this phase's own new files removed (this phase makes zero src/pcae/** changes, so the src tree is byte-identical either way) -- four are pre-existing RAE canonical-provenance forgery-detection failures unrelated to HATP, one is a pre-existing test-methodology false-positive in test_phase_148f_...py's naive substring-based Permission Broker consumer-inventory check, which matches hatp_bootstrap.py's own pre-existing docstring prose (disclaiming, not performing, a permission_broker_foundation import) -- that docstring predates this phase and this phase does not modify hatp_bootstrap.py or the affected test file. Fast Green: 4430 passed / 1 failed -- tests/test_shell_gate.py::TestAuditPersistence::test_audit_verify_cli, confirmed an -n auto-only flake (passes standalone, unrelated file, zero src/pcae/** changes this phase). Runtime state: Observed / observe / unavailable, unchanged before and after this phase. Findings: no BLOCKING findings; four NON-BLOCKING/OBSERVATION findings recorded (bounded TOCTOU window; distinct-principal positive control not exercisable on this single-user dev machine; Wave 1/2 currently has no production caller, an architecture note for future waves; inspect_bootstrap_environment's honest privilege-escalation disclosure). Foundation verification verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS. Foundation readiness: FOUNDATION SOFTWARE READY FOR WAVE 3. Production readiness: HATP PRODUCTION NOT READY (proof schema/serialization/verifier absent, hardware provider absent, Class-B deployment not provisioned, RAE integration absent).
